text:
alex.m: Hey folks — noticed my Feb 28 paystub shows full CA state withholding but I moved to OR on Feb 10 and updated my address in Workday on Feb 11. Net pay down ~ $180. Is that expected?

lina: @alex.m ouch. Did you also submit the relocation form or state change workflow? Workday address alone sometimes isn’t enough before payroll cutoff.

alex.m: I submitted the relocation form on Feb 20 (oops, late). Thought the address change on Feb 11 would be picked up.

jamie: Payroll cutoff is usually Feb 15 for end-of-month runs. If the system snapshot for the run captured CA, it would withhold CA. Marcus?

marcus-payroll: Confirming: payrun 2026-02-28 used the payroll export that had employee_state=CA for employee id 4129. Mid-month moves after cutoff aren’t applied retroactively in the same cycle. We can process an off-cycle adjustment to correct state withholding.

alex.m: Will that be a refund of CA withholding and re-withholding OR? How will it appear on my year-end W-2?

marcus-payroll: We'll refund the excess CA state tax and apply OR withholding pro-rated for the days in OR. For payroll reporting, the net taxable wages won't change; withholding adjustments will reflect on the payroll records and box totals. If the correction happens before year-end, no W-2c is expected. If not corrected until after year close we may need to issue a W-2c.

payroll-bot: payrun 2026-02-28 processed via ADP (batch pr_62481) status: posted.

lina: To proceed we need: 1) confirmation from employee of move date, 2) screenshot of Workday address change, 3) manager approval for off-cycle. Marcus, estimated timeline?

marcus-payroll: If approvals received today: schedule off-cycle next Tue (2026-03-03). ACH can take 1-2 business days to land. Employer filings may show withheld amounts immediately.

alex.m: Confirming move date Feb 10 and attached screenshot to ticket. @jamie approved.

jamie: Approved. Please run correction.

marcus-payroll: Ticket PR-9041 created and assigned. Preview of adjustment lines: 
- "State Withholding Refund (CA)" -45.23
- "State Withholding (OR)" +38.17
Net off-cycle credit: +7.06 to net pay. Reason: mid-month residency change; source: Workday address 2026-02-11.

alex.m: Thanks — will the 401(k) pretax deferral be affected?

marcus-payroll: No, 401(k) deferral is based on gross and stays the same. Only the state tax lines change.

lina: Note for docs: add relocation checklist blurb about payroll cutoff vs address change timing so folks know to submit relocation/state-change workflow before cutoff.

jamie: Agreed — saves time and questions.

payroll-bot: ticket PR-9041 created. Off-cycle ETA: 2026-03-03.

alex.m: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Will wait for off-cycle stub. :slightly_smiling_face:
